并试音后才可登台。幕布下缘缀着蓝色流苏。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"染布工另给窗帘染色，窗帘不用于首演，也不影响琴弦。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-H9UB","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Abbbe5312-606f-4738-9c65-4e4e31a2c1ca:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:bbbe5312-606f-4738-9c65-4e4e31a2c1ca"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["染布工另给窗帘染色，窗帘不用于首演，也不影响琴弦。"]},{"documentId":"D5","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"温宁听到过时消息，以为替弦在右箱；贺弦亲手放过替弦，知道它在左箱，准备按承诺修琴。贺弦依照白线标记打开左箱，取出为首演准备的替弦。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-H9UB","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Afd613533-62d5-4bb4-bc72-1f799e8aad90:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:fd613533-62d5-4bb4-bc72-1f799e8aad90"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["温宁听到过时消息，以为替弦在右箱；贺弦亲手放过替弦，知道它在左箱，准备按承诺修琴。贺弦依照白线标记打开左箱，取出为首演准备的替弦。"]},{"documentId":"D6","title":"温宁","kind":"entity","text":"温宁","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"温宁","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:8bac988f-2e19-47a6-97cf-c9952e59ca2f","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["温宁"]},{"documentId":"D7","title":"贺弦","kind":"entity","text":"贺弦","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"贺弦","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:b4785ab6-dea7-4c0d-8dd4-b9008f378576","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["贺弦"]}]}
